ops.text: The rights of access and use granted to the Company under this Section 1.4 shall extend to the Company's affiliates upon written notice to HDI, and may be transferred to a successor to the Company's business in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added one sentence extending the Section 1.4 access and use rights to our affiliates on written notice to HDI and allowing transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction, which is our fallback licence-scope position. Section 1.4 itself is otherwise unchanged.
proposal.summary: Add one sentence to Section 1.4 covering Company affiliates on written notice and permitting transfer to an M&A successor.

mappings.element: Licence transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction.
